title: Explain AI to others
desc: Prepare and give a clear talk that teaches AI to a younger audience
content_html:
What we're doing

Leaders can explain technology clearly — understanding grows when you can teach it to someone else. If you can explain AI simply, you really understand it.

Activity

Each learner prepares a 3-sentence explanation of AI for a specific audience — a parent, a younger sibling, a head teacher. Practise in pairs, then a few present to the group. The audience scores each on: Was it clear? No jargon? Could you repeat it back? Iterate once and present again.

Key takeaway

A good AI leader makes things clearer for others, not more confusing.

Quick check

A good AI leader should:

  • Confuse others
  • Explain clearly ✔
